title: New MLB url formatting causes error
description:
Thank you for writing this package. However, for 2017 on, the url can't be resolved if the base url has the slash after the DAy_## section, like this:

http://gd2.mlb.com/components/game/mlb/year_2017/month_06/day_14/

Using that last slash gets you an error code. It must be removed from the base url and added to the gid url.

title: XML2R error using local files in version 0.0.6
description:
Hi,

Great package!
I wrote some code using version 0.0.4, using a setup like:
library(XML2R)
x <- XML2R("file.xml")

After deployment on another system using version 0.0.6 the code above stopt working and resulted in an error message:

Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  Could not resolve host: 7; No data record of requested type

This error occurred under windows and linux. installing the 0.0.4 version again resolved the problem.
I could not find any related changes in the documentation, so I think it is a bug.

Best regards,
M
